name: Overcast calm
story: A grey, still, mild day under a flat deck of stratocumulus. Good visibility beneath it, the water like pewter, every sound carrying. At night the town and the dock lights double on the glassy water.
forecast: Overcast, base 750 m, no rain. Wind southeast 3-6 kt. Visibility 30 km below the cloud. Overcast night. The FRONT arrives tomorrow afternoon: gale-force gusts, rain, low cloud.
